meta.name: ultimate-browsing
meta.description: Escalation skill for blocked or hard-to-reach web access — load it when a normal browse/fetch is blocked (WAF, 403, Cloudflare, JS-only render, login-gated, or a platform a generic fetcher cannot read). Tiered router: TIER 1 insane-search (headless extraction + WAF bypass via curl_cffi TLS impersonation, yt-dlp, Jina Reader, public APIs, Playwright real-Chrome fallback); TIER 1.5 agent-reach (platform-native readers for Chinese and social platforms: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, V2EX, WeChat, plus Twitter/Reddit/LinkedIn/GitHub); TIER 2 Chrome stealth (CloakBrowser stealth Chromium + agent-browser CDP for clicks, forms, screenshots, video, cookie login). Triggers: blocked site, bypass bot detection, cloudflare/WAF bypass, scrape, stealth browser, import cookies, fill form, screenshot, play youtube, xiaohongshu, douyin, weibo, bilibili, v2ex, wechat article, podcast transcript. NOT for simple searches (use web-search) or plain fetches (use webfetch).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绕过网页封锁，抓取任何受限内容

copy.tagline_en: Bypass web blocks and scrape any restricted content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often encounter blocked websites or need to scrape dynamically rendered pages

howto.what: 当遇到正常浏览无法打开的网页时，Claude会依次尝试三种方式：先用伪装浏览器绕过反爬（如Cloudflare），再调用平台自有API（如小红书、抖音），最后用隐身浏览器模拟点击、截图、登录等操作，最终获取被封锁的网页内容或执行交互任务。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude打开一个被屏蔽的网址（出现403、WAF、Cloudflare验证），或需要JavaScript渲染、登录后才能访问，或来源是小红书、抖音、微博等平台，且常规的web-search或webfetch无法完成时触发。

say.text: 打开这个被Cloudflare挡住的网页
say.note: Claude会用反爬技术绕过封锁并返回内容。

say.text: 读取这篇文章的正文，网址返回403错误
say.note: Claude会启动隐身浏览器模拟正常访问。

howto.what_en: When normal browsing fails, Claude uses three escalation tiers: first, a headless extractor with WAF bypass; second, platform-native APIs for Chinese/social media; third, a stealth Chromium browser for clicks, screenshots, and logins. It returns the blocked content or completes the interactive task.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to access a blocked URL (403, WAF, Cloudflare), requires JavaScript rendering, login-gated, or from platforms like Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, etc., and regular web-search/webfetch cannot handle it.

say_en.text: Open this page blocked by Cloudflare
say_en.note: Claude will bypass the WAF and fetch the content.

say_en.text: Read this article; the URL returns 403
say_en.note: Claude will launch a stealth browser to simulate normal access.
